remarks: Welcome to 52 Lexington Avenue, a charming 2-bedroom, 2-bath single-family home with untapped potential in one of Norwalk's most dynamic and growing neighborhoods. Situated in a multifamily zone, this property presents an excellent opportunity for investors or future homeowners looking to explore expansion or conversion possibilities. Buyers are responsible for conducting their own due diligence regarding any potential multifamily use.  Inside, the home offers a functional layout with two full bathrooms and versatile living spaces ready for your vision. A walk-up attic adds even more potential-perfect for a home office, studio, flex space, or even a possible third bedroom.  This as-is sale is ideal for those looking to customize or invest in a prime South Norwalk location-just minutes from the vibrant SONO district, train station, restaurants, shops, and waterfront.  Don't miss this exciting opportunity to unlock value in one of Norwalk's most promising areas!
